metadata.description: 2D quasi-steady rigid-body ODE simulation of a thin plate (coin cross-section) falling through fluid (water), based on Andersen, Pesavento & Wang (JFM 2005) and Pesavento & Wang (PRL 2004).

reference.citation: Andersen, A., Pesavento, U., & Wang, Z. J. (2005). Unsteady aerodynamics of fluttering and tumbling plates. Journal of Fluid Mechanics, 541, 65-90.
Pesavento, U., & Wang, Z. J. (2004). Falling of a freely moving flat plate. Physical Review Letters, 93(14), 144501.

file.name: added_mass.py
file.description: Potential-flow added mass tensor (m11, m22, I_a) for an elliptical cross-section.

file.name: forces.py
file.description: Aerodynamic and hydrodynamic forces: angle of attack, Kutta-Joukowski circulation with translational and rotational terms, drag coefficient C_D(alpha), viscous drag forces, and quadratic rotational torque.

file.name: model.py
file.description: Coupled planar 6-DOF Kirchhoff equations of motion, including dimensional circulation lift (rho_f * Gamma * V), potential-flow Munk moment, energy calculations, and lab-frame linear momentum.

file.name: integrate.py
file.description: Scipy solve_ivp wrapper utilizing DOP853 with adaptive t_max, dense time sampling, terminal bottom-hit event, and timeout detection.

file.name: dimensionless.py
file.description: Evaluates dimensionless groups (I*, Re, St, U_t) and classifies trajectory regime (steady, fluttering, tumbling, mixed).

file.name: metrics.py
file.description: Trajectory post-processing: FFT frequency analysis, dominant Strouhal number, tilt variance, and mechanical energy budget reconciliation.

file.name: sweeps.py
file.description: Orchestration engines for executing parameter sweeps (I* sweep, release angle sweep, chaos dispersion ensemble).

file.name: plotting.py
file.description: Publication-quality visualization suite enforcing 300 DPI, vector PDF output, high-contrast styling, and required simulation captions.

file.description: CLI runner for a single plate drop, exporting trajectory CSV and 3-panel figure.

file.name: test_added_mass.py
file.description: Acceptance Test 1: Verifies circular limit (m11=m22, I_a=0) and thin plate limits.

file.name: test_forces.py
file.description: Acceptance Tests 2 and 4: Verifies Kirchhoff kinetic energy and lab momentum conservation with forces off, constant velocity for circular plate, and vertical symmetry preservation without perturbations.

file.name: test_terminal_velocity.py
file.description: Acceptance Test 3: Verifies broadside terminal velocity matches analytical drag balance to within 0.05% (< 2% requirement).

file.name: test_energy.py
file.description: Acceptance Test 5: Reconciles potential, translational kinetic, rotational kinetic, and dissipated work to within 1e-4% of potential energy drop.

file.name: test_regimes.py
file.description: Acceptance Test 6: Verifies regime ordering (fluttering at low I*, tumbling at high I*) and classifier threshold robustness under +/-20% variation.

file.name: test_numerics.py
file.description: Acceptance Tests 7 and 8: Verifies numerical convergence (< 1e-6% chord change upon 10x tolerance tightening) and byte-identical reproducibility with fixed seed.

file.name: test_dimensions_and_lift.py
file.description: Audit Tests: Verifies implied lift coefficient peaks at 1.2000 at alpha=45 deg, and confirms dimensional consistency (N/m for linear ODEs, N for angular ODE) across all force terms.

file.description: Formal external review report with test results, full coefficient table, sweep statistics, and physics diagnosis.

variable.description: Tilt angle of major axis from +X

equation.formula: (m + m11) * du/dt = (m + m22)*v*omega - rho_f*Gamma*v - F_u - (m - m_f)*g*sin(theta)
(m + m22) * dv/dt = -(m + m11)*u*omega + rho_f*Gamma*u - F_v - (m - m_f)*g*cos(theta)

parameter.role: Translational circulation prefactor (yields peak C_L = 1.2 at 45 deg)

term.name: lift_forces
term.formula: F_lift_u = rho_f * Gamma * v, F_lift_v = rho_f * Gamma * u

term.name: viscous_drag
term.formula: F_u = 0.5 * rho_f * L * C_D(alpha) * |V| * u, F_v = 0.5 * rho_f * L * C_D(alpha) * |V| * v

term.name: rotational_torque
term.formula: tau = 0.5 * C_tau * rho_f * L^4 * |omega| * omega + c_lin * omega

parameter.rationale: Strip theory derivation: C_tau = C_D / 32 with C_D approx 2.4

group.description: Dimensionless moment of inertia for thin 2D plate
Reynolds number evaluated a posteriori from mean descent speed U
Strouhal number from dominant oscillation frequency f

regime.name: mixed
regime.criterion: chaotic or irregular motion (e.g. flutter with intermittent flips)

test.name: test_no_forces_circular_plate_constant_velocity

test.name: test_broadside_terminal_velocity
test.result: Broadside terminal speed matches drag balance within 0.05% (< 2% threshold)

test.name: test_sign_check_and_symmetry

test.name: test_energy_budget_closure_heavy_coin

test.name: test_regime_ordering_transition
test.result: Fluttering observed at low I*, tumbling emerges cleanly at I* >= 1.07

test.name: test_regime_threshold_sensitivity
test.result: Regime classifications invariant under +/- 20% threshold variations

test.name: test_numerical_convergence_tolerance_tightening

range.behavior: Tumbling (n_flips > 40, sustained autorotation, > 1.5 m lateral glide)

Broad flutter-glide, lateral drift up to 0.45 m
Rapid entry into autorotative tumbling, lateral drift exceeding 1.5 m
